prompt: Toronto → Mumbai in November · 2 adults, 2 kids (4 & 7) + grandma · Canadian passports

events.prompt: Toronto → Mumbai in November · 2 adults, 2 kids (4 & 7) + grandma · Canadian passports

events.text: Searching the recorded fare snapshot and checking family logistics in parallel.

events.task: Price YYZ→BOM direct baseline and stopover leg pairs via candidate cities for November.
Assess stopover candidates for Canadian passports, two young kids and a senior: visa friction, airport comfort, stroller/wheelchair reality.

events.summary: DXB: visa-free 30d (CA), stroller lanes, reliable wheelchair service, summer heat caveat
IST: e-Visa ~$85/person (CA), free Touristanbul tours, cobblestones fight strollers
DOH: visa-free (CA), compact airport rated best for comfort, flat senior-friendly city

events.report: Direct baseline: $849 (2 stops, 24h door-to-door) or $1,072 (1 stop). Stopover pairs per seat: DXB $1,107 (641+466, both nonstop) · IST $1,066 (598+468) · DOH $1,123 (702+421). SIN pair prices out at $1,500 — dropped.

DXB: best all-round for this family — visa-free, stroller lanes, dependable wheelchair assist; November weather ideal. IST: cheapest friction is financial (~$85/person e-Visa); old town is magic but hard with a stroller. DOH: visa-free and calm, better suited to 2–3 quiet days. No showstoppers.

events.task: Compute all-in costs and worth-it scores. Direct $849/seat (24h, 2 stops). Pairs per seat: DXB $1,107 · IST $1,066 · DOH $1,123. Family needs 2 hotel rooms.

events.report: DXB: +$258/seat in flights + ~$1,160 hotels buys 5 days and splits 24h of travel into 12.5h + 3h — score 86. IST: +$217/seat + ~$570 hotels for 4 days — score 81. DOH: +$274/seat + ~$480 for a calmer 3 days — score 72. All hotel figures are estimates.

events.text: Draft: Dubai first for this family (fatigue split + accessibility beat the price gap), Istanbul as the budget pick, Doha for a quieter pace. Sending the draft and the full evidence log to the verifier before anything reaches the user.

events.task: Audit the draft verdict — every fare, visa rule, hotel figure and score — against the raw evidence log.

events.report: All fares match search_flights results exactly — VERIFIED. Hotel totals derive from estimate_hotel_cost — ESTIMATED, and the draft labels them as estimates. Visa claims match editorial city facts. Because hotel estimates are load-bearing in the all-in figures, every option is marked dataStatus: estimated, not verified. APPROVED.

verdict.summary: Yes — a stopover beats the 24-hour sprint for this family. Dubai adds 5 vacation days and cuts the longest leg to 12.5 hours for $258 more per seat; Istanbul is the budget pick at +$217.

options.highlight: Longest leg drops from 24h to a 12.5h nonstop — nap-schedule friendly, and DXB's wheelchair service is dependable for grandma
options.caution: Two hotel rooms are the real cost: budget roughly $2.3K extra for the whole family

options.highlight: Cheapest way to turn the journey into a holiday — both legs nonstop, hotels from $95/night
options.caution: Old-town cobblestones are a fight with a stroller; e-Visa fees add ~$425 for five travellers

options.highlight: Calmest option: compact top-rated airport, flat accessible city — easiest on the senior traveller
options.caution: Two to three days is the ceiling before Doha runs quiet for young kids
